items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C² and 0<α≤β, with α‖a‖²≤D²V(x)[a,a]≤β‖a‖² for every x,a. Suppose η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ as the normalized volume tilt exp(-V), J as the actual law of (X,X+√η G) for independent X∼μ and standard Gaussian G, ν=J.snd, Λ as the law of (Y,2X-Y), and F(x,y)=(x,2x-y). The theorem produces probability of μ,J,ν and common Markov kernels R,S, with swapped J disintegrated by R, every-y reflected S, its exact normalized density, and Λ=ν⊗S. On the actual Hilbert space L²(J), P is conditional projection given Y; one common U is the genuine reflection pullback, a self-adjoint isometric involution. With authored aliases A=PUP, B=(I-P)UP and D=(I-P)U(I-P), B*B=P-A² and B*D=-AB*. For every Pg=g, ‖Bg‖²=‖g‖²-‖Ag‖². For each signed smooth compactly supported f, the literal Tf(y)=∫f(u)S_y(du) is differentiable, f,Tf,∇Tf lie in L²(ν), and Var_Sf lies in L¹(ν). A genuine class g=[f∘snd] satisfies Pg=g and Ag=[Tf∘snd]; its actual squared norm and the squared norm of Ag equal ∫f²dν and ∫(Tf)²dν. Moreover ∫Var_Sf dν=‖Bg‖² and η∫‖∇Tf‖²dν≤(1-αη)²/[4(1+αη)]‖Bg‖². No centering or law, operator, representative, domain or bound certificate is a public assumption.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E with Borel structure; rank zero is an explicit authored extension of the source Euclidean setting.
Globally C² potential V; 0<α≤β and the genuine pointwise Hessian bounds α‖a‖²≤D²V(x)[a,a]≤β‖a‖².
Positive step η with βη≤1, exactly the source restriction.
Signed smooth compactly supported f. All probabilities, kernels, L² classes, differentiability, L²/L¹ domains and block/variance identities are produced internally.
